<script lang="ts">
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { Attachment } from "svelte/attachments";
	import type { ButtonActionProps } from "./index.js";
	let { element = $bindable(), variant = "outline", size, rounded, disabled = false, children, ...props }: ButtonActionProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();

	/** Shares the button element through `bind:element`. */
	const bindElement: Attachment<HTMLButtonElement> = (node) => {
		element = node;
		return () => (element = undefined);
	};
</script>

<!-- Pill action button; disabled while the prompt is sending. -->
<Button type="button" {variant} size={size ?? ctx.controlSize} rounded={rounded ?? ctx.controlRounded} disabled={disabled || ctx.sending} {@attach bindElement} {...props}>
	{@render children?.()}
</Button>

<script lang="ts">
	import { createAttachmentKey } from "svelte/attachments";
	import { PlusIcon } from "@lucide/svelte";
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent } from "#lib/components/ui/tooltip/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { FilesButtonProps, PromptInputTriggerAttrs } from "./index.js";
	let { element = $bindable(), tooltip = "Add images", trigger: customTrigger, variant = "ghost", size, rounded, disabled = false, children, onclick, ...props }: FilesButtonProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Created once, so the element binding does not re-attach each time the props change.
	const attachmentKey = createAttachmentKey();
	// Props for the default button or a custom trigger.
	const triggerProps: PromptInputTriggerAttrs = $derived({ type: "button", disabled: disabled || ctx.sending || ctx.files.length >= ctx.maxFiles, "aria-label": tooltip, onclick: handleClick, [attachmentKey]: bindElement });

	/** Shares the trigger element through `bind:element`. */
	function bindElement(node: HTMLElement) {
		element = node;
		return () => (element = undefined);
	}

	/** Opens the file picker, unless the passed handler prevented it. */
	function handleClick(e: MouseEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLElement }) {
		onclick?.(e);
		if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.fileInputEl?.click();
	}
</script>

<!-- Button that opens the file picker, named by its tooltip; a custom trigger keeps the tooltip. -->
<Tooltip side="bottom" align="start" arrow={false} delay={100}>
	<TooltipTrigger>
		{#snippet trigger({ props: tooltipProps })}
			{#if customTrigger}
				{@render customTrigger({ props: { ...tooltipProps, ...triggerProps } })}
			{:else}
				<Button {variant} size={size ?? `icon-${ctx.controlSize}`} rounded={rounded ?? ctx.controlRounded} {...tooltipProps} {...props} {...triggerProps}>
					{#if children}
						{@render children()}
					{:else}
						<PlusIcon style="width: 1.5rem;height: 1.5rem;" />
					{/if}
				</Button>
			{/if}
		{/snippet}
	</TooltipTrigger>
	<TooltipContent>{tooltip}</TooltipContent>
</Tooltip>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem } from "#lib/components/ui/select/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { Attachment } from "svelte/attachments";
	import type { SelectProps } from "./index.js";
	let { element = $bindable(), options, selected = $bindable(Object.keys(options)[0] ?? ""), open = $bindable(false), name, required, disabled = false, onSelectedChange, onOpenChange, variant, size, rounded, placeholder = "Select an option", class: className, ...props }: SelectProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const entries = $derived(Object.entries(options));

	/** Shares the trigger element through `bind:element`. */
	const bindElement: Attachment<HTMLButtonElement> = (node) => {
		element = node;
		return () => (element = undefined);
	};
</script>

<!-- Option picker, such as the AI model; blocked while the prompt is sending. -->
<Select bind:value={selected} bind:open {name} {required} onValueChange={onSelectedChange} {onOpenChange} {variant} size={size ?? ctx.controlSize} rounded={rounded ?? ctx.controlRounded} disabled={disabled || ctx.sending}>
	<SelectTrigger class={["promptInputSelect", className]} {...props} {@attach bindElement}>
		<SelectValue {placeholder} label={options[selected]} />
	</SelectTrigger>
	<SelectContent>
		{#each entries as [optionValue, label] (optionValue)}
			<SelectItem value={optionValue} {label}>{label}</SelectItem>
		{/each}
	</SelectContent>
</Select>

<style>
	/* Muted until hovered, like the other prompt controls */
	/* Scoped under the prompt box so it outranks the select's own text color */
	:global(.promptInput .selectTrigger.promptInputSelect) {
		color: var(--muted-foreground);
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import { createAttachmentKey } from "svelte/attachments";
	import { ArrowUpIcon, LoaderCircleIcon } from "@lucide/svelte";
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { PromptInputTriggerAttrs, SubmitProps } from "./index.js";
	let { element = $bindable(), trigger, variant = "default", size, rounded, disabled = false, "aria-label": ariaLabel, children, class: className, ...props }: SubmitProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	// Created once, so the element binding does not re-attach each time the props change.
	const attachmentKey = createAttachmentKey();
	// Props for the default button or a custom trigger.
	const triggerProps: PromptInputTriggerAttrs = $derived({ type: "submit", disabled: disabled || !ctx.isReady, "aria-label": ariaLabel ?? (ctx.sending ? "Sending" : "Send prompt"), [attachmentKey]: bindElement });

	/** Shares the trigger element through `bind:element`. */
	function bindElement(node: HTMLElement) {
		element = node;
		return () => (element = undefined);
	}
</script>

<!-- Send button at the end of the actions; a custom trigger gets the sending and ready states for its own look. -->
{#if trigger}
	{@render trigger({ props: triggerProps, sending: ctx.sending, ready: ctx.isReady })}
{:else}
	<Button {variant} size={size ?? `icon-${ctx.controlSize}`} rounded={rounded ?? ctx.controlRounded} class={["promptInputSubmit", className]} {...props} {...triggerProps}>
		{#if ctx.sending}
			<LoaderCircleIcon class="promptInputSpin" />
		{:else if children}
			{@render children()}
		{:else}
			<ArrowUpIcon />
		{/if}
	</Button>
{/if}

<style>
	/* Pushed to the end of the actions row */
	:global(.promptInputSubmit) {
		margin-left: auto;
	}

	:global(.promptInputSpin) {
		animation: promptInputSpin 1s linear infinite;
	}

	@keyframes promptInputSpin {
		to {
			transform: rotate(360deg);
		}
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from "svelte";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { TextareaProps } from "./index.js";
	let { element = $bindable(), name = "text", placeholder = "Ask anything…", onkeydown, oninput, class: className, ...props }: TextareaProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();

	// Restore a saved draft when the prompt starts empty.
	onMount(() => {
		if (ctx.draftKey && !ctx.text) ctx.text = localStorage.getItem(ctx.draftKey) ?? "";
	});

	// Fit the height to the text whenever it or the size changes, such as typing, a restored draft, or a cleared prompt.
	$effect(() => {
		void ctx.text;
		void ctx.size;
		resize();
	});

	/** Grows the textarea to fit its text, one line height at a time, up to the max height where it scrolls. */
	function resize() {
		if (!element) return;
		// Reset first so the scroll height measures the text instead of the current height.
		element.style.height = "auto";
		element.style.height = `${element.scrollHeight}px`;
	}

	/** Sends on Enter; Shift and Enter, and Enter on touch keyboards, add a new line instead. */
	const handleKeydown = (e: KeyboardEvent & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLTextAreaElement }) => {
		onkeydown?.(e);
		// If another handler took the key, text is being composed, or it is not a plain Enter: leave it.
		if (e.defaultPrevented || e.isComposing || e.key !== "Enter" || e.shiftKey) return;
		// If the device types on a touch keyboard: Enter adds a new line, and the send button sends.
		if (window.matchMedia("(pointer: coarse)").matches) return;
		e.preventDefault();
		// Submit through the form, so Enter runs the same `onsubmit`, `onSubmit`, or native submit as the send button.
		element?.form?.requestSubmit();
	};

	/** Saves the draft as the user types. */
	const handleInput = (e: Event & { currentTarget: EventTarget & HTMLTextAreaElement }) => {
		oninput?.(e);
		ctx.saveDraft();
	};
</script>

<!-- Prompt text; read-only while sending, so it stays visible and selectable. The top and bottom fade while it scrolls, in CSS alone. -->
<textarea bind:this={element} bind:value={ctx.text} class={["promptInputTextarea scroll-fade-y", className]} {name} {placeholder} rows="1" readonly={ctx.sending} onkeydown={handleKeydown} oninput={handleInput} {...props}></textarea>

<style>
	/* Borderless field that grows with its text */
	.promptInputTextarea {
		box-sizing: border-box;
		outline: none;
		border: 0;
		background: transparent;
		padding: 0;
		width: 100%;
		min-height: var(--prompt-input-min-height);
		max-height: 12rem; /* 192px */
		resize: none;
		color: inherit;
		font: inherit;
		font-size: var(--prompt-input-text);
		line-height: var(--prompt-input-line-height);
	}

	.promptInputTextarea::placeholder {
		color: var(--muted-foreground);
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* Sending */
	.promptInputTextarea[readonly] {
		cursor: not-allowed;
		color: var(--muted-foreground);
	}
</style>
